item.title: Court hears how 25-year-old accused beat mother severally in domestic row
item.description: 25-year-old in the dock with domestic violence charges after allegedly beating his mother

item.title: Labour MP urges better pollution laws after black plume gushes out of Qormi factory
item.description: A video showing a thick black plume billowing from an Qormi factor has prompted a Labour MP to call for legal reform that protects residents from harmful emissions

item.title: PN to table Private Member’s Bill aimed at tackling loneliness
item.description: Opposition Shadow minister for the fight against poverty and loneliness Ivan Bartolo says proposed legislation seeks to intensify national efforts to ensure that no one feels forgotten or alone

item.title: Service dogs graduate from preparatory programme to assist people
item.description: Five dogs, Balto, Dom, Sam, Pablo and Kaydi , will be able to help people with different conditions

item.title: Government broke rules to transfer public service employees to Michelle Muscats NGOs
item.description: Employees seconded from the public sector to the Marigold Foundation and the National Alliance were paid more than they were supposed to, while their work wasn't monitored by government

item.title: Court hears of seized passports amid threats in prostitution trafficking case
item.description: Woman testifies she felt pressured into prostitution, had her passport withheld, and lived in fear after arriving in Malta, as proceedings begin against Fabio Vespa on charges linked to the trafficking of women for sexual exploitation

item.title: Austin Mallia found guilty by 7–2 jury verdict in cannabis trafficking case
item.description: Jury finds Austin Mallia guilty by 7–2 of aggravated cannabis possession and association for the purpose of trafficking, exposing him to a potential life sentence

item.title: Academy Award winner Robert Duvall dies aged 95
item.description: Robert Duvall, who starred in The Godfather and Apocalypse Now, dies aged 95

item.title: Machines helped collect 283 million plastic bottles in 2025
item.description: In 2021, Malta was among the EU’s worst countries when it comes to recycling. Four years later, Malta would recycle 283 million plastic bottles in one year alone, and all it took was a refund of 10c per bottle to the recycler

item.title: The dating game: It’s a jungle out there
item.description: I often read questions by single people asking, 'where do you go to socialise? How can I make new friends?' and I always feel this is a sad indication that for all our technological progress, so many who are still on their own have never been so lonely
